_comment: Every field here is read from a document the learner supplied, and the
source is recorded so somebody can check it. Nothing is inferred: a fact
no source states is left empty.
The question bank is NOT here. Past papers and question banks are the
learner's own material and are not ours to redistribute, so the bank
lives in the app's data directory and is written by
The course record is 'PENDING_REVIEW' rather than 'VERIFIED': the fields
are sourced, but nobody has yet checked this catalogue against official
SRM material. The importer, not this file, produces the questions.

courses.syllabus_source: Unit-wise course material supplied by the learner (PPS UNIT I-V notes, slides and the course question bank). This is the course's own teaching material, not an official published syllabus.
courses.syllabus_version: Course code 21CSS101J (2021 regulation). Some of the supplied material carries the earlier code 18CSS101J, so both appear; the papers themselves use 21CSS101J.
courses.exam_pattern: Cycle Test I: 25 marks, 50 minutes, Part A = 10 x 1 mark MCQ, plus Part B. Read from the CT-1 paper headers. The end-semester pattern (75 marks / 3 hours / Part A 20 x 1) was read from a scanned paper and is NOT yet confirmed.
